title: CRIS System — Successor to Metis
notes: European open tender for research information system to replace Metis. Awarded to Vidatum — direct loss for Elsevier Pure. Both Radboud University and Radboud UMC signed. Go-live Q1 2027.

title: Web of Science Licence Non-Renewal
notes: UT decided not to renew Clarivate Web of Science (incl. JCR + ESI). Scopus explicitly cited as the preferred alternative. Win by default for Elsevier. Licence ended Dec 31 2025.

title: Web of Science Access Termination
notes: VU Amsterdam terminated Web of Science access effective January 1 2026. Cited Barcelona Declaration on Open Research Information + cost >€100K. Scopus retained as primary database.

title: SURF National Read & Publish + Scopus Deal
notes: 2-year national Read & Publish + Scopus deal signed Jan 2025 via SURF. Covers UNL, NFU, NWO-i, KNAW, 23 universities of applied science. 100% OA publishing included. Optional 3rd-year extension. Renewal due late 2026.

title: IReL Framework — ScienceDirect / Scopus / SciVal
notes: TED ref 598844-2025. €42.1M, 72-month open framework for ScienceDirect, Scopus, SciVal and Knovel. Cancelled — zero responses received. Elsevier unwilling to compete on open tender format. Watch for re-tender.
